summary: On the main deck, Trinity screams as the monitors jump back to life, and Tank and Morpheus look at each other as if it is a miracle. Trinity then commands, 'Now get up!'

what_changes.before: In tears, Morpheus takes hold of the EMP switch. Trinity whispers in Neo's ear.
what_changes.after: Trinity screams as the monitors jump back to life.
what_changes.evidence: Trinity screams as the monitors jump back to life.

what_changes.before: Morpheus takes hold of the EMP switch.
what_changes.after: Tank and Morpheus look at each other. It is a miracle.
what_changes.evidence: Tank and Morpheus look at each other. It is a miracle.

event_hint.one_line: The crew's grief over Neo's death is interrupted when the monitors return to life and Trinity calls for action.
